subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should Google Chat all-message Space ingestion be implemented through user OAuth, Google Workspace Events/Pub/Sub, or left unsupported until a safer channel-auth design exists?
rationale: The remaining request changes what Space messages OpenClaw can receive and likely adds credential/config/event scope, so automation cannot safely pick the product and security boundary.

options.title: Design OAuth or Workspace Events path
options.body: Define the supported auth/events model, required scopes, setup docs, safe defaults, fallback behavior, and validation before implementation work starts.

options.title: Document service-account mention-only mode
options.body: Keep service-account Google Chat as mention-gated and document that receiving every Space message is unsupported for now.

options.title: Split thread work from ingestion
options.body: Resolve the thread-reply/session PRs separately and keep all-message ingestion under the OAuth/security design track.

recommendation.title: Design OAuth or Workspace Events path
recommendation.body: Define the supported auth/events model, required scopes, setup docs, safe defaults, fallback behavior, and validation before implementation work starts.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent maintainer review and merge history on the closest Google Chat thread and OAuth design items.
